identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1-2 Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of IM19 CAR-T Cells in Patients With Relapsed and Refractory (R/R) Mantle Cell Lymphoma

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of adverse events (AEs) and abnormal laboratory test results as assessed by CTCAE V5.0
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days after IM19 CAR-T cell infusion

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR, defined as the proportion of participants with a complete response or partial response, as determined by the investigator according to Lugano(2014)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At 3 months after IM19 CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR, defined as the proportion of participants with a complete response or partial response, as determined by the investigator according to Lugano(2014)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: At 28 days and 6 months after IM19 CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS, defined as the time from CAR-T cell infusion to the first occurrence of disease progression or death from any cause (whichever occurs first) , as determined by the investigator according to Lugano(2014)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 weeks after IM19 CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR, defined as the time from the first occurrence of a documented objective response to disease progression or death from any cause (whichever occurs first) in Stage 1, as determined by the investigator according to Lugano(2014)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 weeks after IM19 CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS , defined as the time from IM19 CAR-T cell infusion to death from any cause
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 weeks after CAR-T cell infusion

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Persistence of CAR-T cells (cell counts and cell percentage in peripheral blood)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The persistence over time of CAR T cells in the peripheral blood as determined by flow cytometry and qPCR
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 24 weeks after IM19 CAR-T cell infusion
Up to 24 weeks after IM19 CAR-T cell infusion
